title: Onboarding motionless spotlight stills and changelog tile pack
creator: Aisha N'diaye
description: Produce a static image pack (no animations) for the upcoming release notes and quickstart docs. Deliverables include hero stills, feature callout overlays, before/after UI comparison plates, mobile and desktop crops, and a compact tile set for changelog cards. Images should be export-ready for blog header, docs header, and marketplace thumbnails. Include light/dark mode variants and alt-text suggestions for all assets.
acceptance_criteria: Hero image (desktop) exported in 1920x1080, optimized PNG and WebP, with alt text and caption
Hero image (mobile crop) exported in 1200x800 and safe crop guides provided
Three before/after comparison plates: Authentication flow, Model selection panel, and Console rollout UI; each with annotated callouts (max 6 labels per plate)
A set of 8 changelog tiles: 4 feature-highlight tiles, 2 micro-before/after tiles, 2 thumbnail variants for docs list
Light and dark mode variants for all deliverables, with WCAG AA color contrast checked and notes
Figma file finalized with named export frames and production-ready filenames, linked in ticket
PRD/Docs writer has approved copy and captions (pm-approval comment present)

Callouts will use Redwood brand accent (teal-500) for new state and neutral-600 for legacy state; stroke added to labels for legibility in dark mode
